patientForm.registerSubtitle: The patient record and their consent are captured in one step
patientForm.editSubtitle: Every change here is written to the change log
patientForm.fullNameHint: Write the name as the patient says it — messages use it to address them
patientForm.phoneHint: Type it as the patient gave it (01001234567); the country code is added for you
patientForm.timeZoneHint: Dose times are read in this zone. Defaults to the pharmacy's.
patientForm.careNotesHint: Optional — anything the team should know: allergies, chronic conditions, circumstances
patientForm.externalRefHint: Optional — the paper file number, or a number from another system
patientForm.statusHint: Paused also stops reminders until you take them off hold
patientForm.consentIntro: Consent is recorded together with the patient, not as a separate chore afterwards.
patientForm.consentAppendNote: Consent is a history: saving here adds a new record and does not change the older one.
patientForm.consentWhatsappHint: No reminder can be sent without this
patientForm.consentWhatsappMissing: Without this consent nothing reaches the patient, and the record stays silent without flagging it
patientForm.consentDataProcessingHint: The baseline consent for holding and following up this patient's data
patientForm.consentEvidenceRefHint: Optional — the signed form's number, or where its photo is stored
patientForm.duplicatePhoneTitle: This number is already registered to another patient
patientForm.duplicatePhoneHint: That is allowed — family members share a handset and both records are saved. Be aware that a reply from it can be attributed to the wrong person, so a second number is better if there is one.

errors.INVALID_PHONE: That is not a valid mobile number — use the local form 01001234567, or include the country code
errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: Choose a time zone from the list
errors.FORBIDDEN_CONSENT: You are not allowed to record consent — ask the pharmacy manager
